title: Nourishing Fluffy Peruvian Bread Rolls Skewers
description: A nostalgic Peruvian dish featuring fluffy bread rolls, grilled to perfection, and served on skewers, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the bread rolls into 1 inch cubes.
Thread 3-4 bread cubes onto each skewer.
Brush the melted butter onto the bread cubes.
Sprinkle the grated cheese, chopped parsley, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper onto the bread cubes.
Dip each skewer into the beaten egg for extra moisture.
Place the skewers onto the preheated grill and cook for 5-7 minutes on each side.
Serve the skewers warm and enjoy.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to prevent burning.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
